title: Induction Period Reader
description:
A single-page browser tool that reads the induction period off a Rancimat conductivity trace by fitting the four-parameter kappa response, and reports both readings admitted by the standard, the steepest-tangent reading and the second-derivative reading, with bootstrap intervals.

The fit runs entirely in the visitor's browser; nothing is uploaded and nothing is stored.

The MIT licence covers the code only. The conductivity traces distributed with the repository are included with written permission and are not covered by it; see NOTICE.
